comparsas.title: Comparsas
comparsas.description: The Federation's comparsas and the firing chiefs who manage them.
comparsas.caption: Comparsas

unassigned.title: No comparsa assigned to you yet
unassigned.description: An administrator of the Federation has to assign you to your comparsa.

form.newDescription: Its name must be unique. Firing chiefs are assigned from its page.
form.name: Name

detail.inactiveNotice: This comparsa is inactive: it keeps its history but gets no new firing chiefs.

actions.title: Actions
actions.deactivateDescription: It keeps its history and its firing chiefs, but no new ones can be assigned until you reactivate it.
actions.deleteDescription_one: This cannot be undone. {{count}} firing chief will lose access to it.
actions.deleteDescription_other: This cannot be undone. {{count}} firing chiefs will lose access to it.
actions.deleteDescriptionUnknown: This cannot be undone. Its firing chiefs, if any, will lose access to it.

logo.help: A PNG with a transparent background is recommended. The long side must be at least 256 px and no more than 3 times the short side. It is stored as a PNG of at most 1024 px.
logo.label: comparsa logo
logo.removeDescription: The image will be erased. The comparsa will show the generic symbol until you upload another one.

comparsas.figuresFailed: Not all the comparsa figures could be loaded.

logo.help: Printed on the pickup authorisation form (and later on the badges). A PNG with a transparent background is recommended. The long side must be at least 256 px and no more than 3 times the short one. It is stored as a PNG of at most 1024 px.
logo.label: Federation logo
logo.loadFailed: The Federation logo could not be loaded.
logo.staleFailed: The Federation logo could not be refreshed: what you see may be outdated.
logo.removeDescription: The image will be deleted. Documents will be printed without a logo until you upload another.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The Federation's details used by documents, emails and reminders. Each section is saved on its own.
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
settings.staleFailed: The settings could not be refreshed: what you see may be out of date.

identity.title: Identity
identity.name: the identity
identity.usedIn: The official name is printed on badges and the pickup authorisation; the short name and the contact appear at the end of notification emails.
identity.websiteHint: A full https address, for example https://www.example.org.
identity.federationOnly: The email and website must be the Federation's, never a person's: they are sent with every notification.

emails.title: Emails
emails.name: the emails
emails.usedIn: Used in every PolvorApp email: notifications, invitations and password changes.
emails.senderNameHint: Shown with the address {{address}}, which is set on the server. It cannot contain quotation marks, angle brackets or the at sign.
emails.replyToHint: Replies to the emails go to this address. Without it, they go to the sender address.

orders.title: Orders
orders.name: the orders
orders.usedIn: Sets when firing chiefs get the first reminder that the orders are closing.
orders.closeReminderHint: The first reminder is sent between this many days and two days before the planned close. Raising it can send a reminder sooner than expected.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.name: the calendar
calendar.usedIn: Sets when milestones with reminders on are announced.
calendar.milestoneLeadHint: How many days before a milestone its reminder is sent.

validation.email: Enter a full email address, such as info@example.org.
validation.website: Enter a full https address without spaces or quotes, such as https://www.example.org.
validation.senderName: The name cannot contain quotation marks, angle brackets (< >) or the at sign (@).
validation.outOfRange: Choose one of the values in the list.

errors.modified: Someone else changed the settings while you were editing. Check the current values and save again.
errors.busy: The settings are being saved from another session. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.tooManyRequests: You saved too many changes in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.reloadFailed: The current values could not be loaded: try again in a few seconds.

firingChiefs.title: Firing chiefs
firingChiefs.description: Users who manage this comparsa. They only see the comparsas assigned to them.
firingChiefs.empty: No firing chief is assigned yet.
firingChiefs.noCandidates: Every firing chief who can be assigned is already here.
firingChiefs.inactiveComparsa: Reactivate the comparsa to assign new firing chiefs.
firingChiefs.removeDescription: They will no longer see this comparsa from their next action.
firingChiefs.added: {{name}} is now a firing chief of this comparsa.
firingChiefs.removed: {{name}} is no longer a firing chief of this comparsa.
firingChiefs.caption: Firing chiefs of {{name}}

userComparsas.title: Comparsas
userComparsas.description: The comparsas this firing chief manages. They only see these.
userComparsas.empty: This firing chief has no comparsa yet.
userComparsas.noCandidates: There is no other active comparsa to assign.
userComparsas.removeDescription: The firing chief will no longer see it from their next action.
userComparsas.adminNoEffect: This user is an administrator and sees every comparsa. These assignments have no effect unless they become a firing chief again.
userComparsas.caption: Comparsas of {{name}}

weaponModels.title: Weapon models
weaponModels.description: The Federation's catalogue: owned weapons and rentals use these models.
weaponModels.caption: Weapon models

form.label: Name
form.labelHint: As the Federation writes it, e.g. TRABUCO CRISTIANO DIESTRO (PEQUEÑO).
form.pistolHint: For pistols, side, handedness and size are optional.

detail.inactiveNotice: This model is inactive: it is kept for history but not offered for new records.

actions.title: Actions
actions.deactivateDescription: It is kept for history but not offered for new records until you reactivate it.

file.required: No image was received. Choose it again.
file.tooLarge: The logo is too large: at most 10 MB and 40 megapixels.
file.unsupportedFormat: The file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image. SVG is not accepted.
file.tooSmall: The logo is too small: it needs at least 256 px on the long side.
file.aspectRatio: The logo is too elongated: the long side cannot be more than 3 times the short one.
